answer: A sybil farm is a spreadsheet that only works when identities cost nothing. Enrolled school inspector commission with school inspectors verification rewrites the spreadsheet — a commission inspectors issue after assessed visits — and the ferrous of every row becomes a real expense. One proof is within reach, ten are a stretch, but the wharf of a hundred runs into weeks of labour and thousands in fees chasing a reward that shrinks per head. The walnut is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
